note: Design round 10 (v12-totem.md 3.0-3.5), the last day, the option picked on 2026-11-03: last-mark. rows are copied from the design's totem-lastday.json verbatim, as build-10.mjs drew them after the picks with the owner's two amendments (3.0): alone, the idol is centred in its well (form A: the wings around a two-cell face with a • eye in each half); beside its mark it shifts left (form B: the picked cells, the ¨ eyes, and the mark in the well's last cell: the last day's yellow ! or the pop's white ✦); and no count is ever drawn on the totem, as a Totem of Undying does not stack, so r-two and l-two-23h carry exactly the totem cells of r-safe and l-safe-23h. Each row is the full HUD (5 lines, roles top, hearts, xp, hot, edge): dist/hungerbar.mjs rendering the situation's payload in the media rig's sandbox (scripts/media/rig.mjs, the normal day of scripts/media/scenes/looks.mjs with hud.pr on, align left, user off) with hud.totem off, then the option painted onto the feature's cells by the moves of design 2.2; spaces are U+00A0, as Hungerbar prints them. situations are the design's inputs: the 5-hour window's used %, the week (60% left), the credits, the totems declared (n, kind, ends in hours), ctx.pop (the age of the pop in seconds: 0 it fell now, 30 over; null no fall seen) and ctx.until (the reset's end, epoch seconds). test/unit/hud-totem.test.ts renders each through Hungerbar with hud.totem on and the totems declared, and compares span for span.
name: A yellow mark
optionNote: In its last 24 h a bold yellow ! stands in the well's last cell and the idol shifts left to make room (form B); the same ! for any number held. The totem stays where it is.
title: The last day
intro: A reset can expire, and an expired reset is gone. These options decide what the HUD does in a reset's last 24 hours. Drawn with the recommended shape, the golden idol; whatever shape you pick takes its place.

situations.label: Safe, the reset ends in 23 h
situations.note: Every limit fine; its last 24 hours have begun.

situations.label: Two held, ending in 23 h
situations.note: The same ! for 2 held: there is no count to turn yellow; the cells of l-safe-23h.

situations.label: Dying (5-hour 7%), ends in 23 h
situations.note: The suggestion would move it anyway; only the mark differs.

situations.label: Safe, ends in 3 days
situations.note: Not the last day: all three options draw the same.

situations.label: The call, ends in 23 h (5 minutes after the fall)
situations.note: The 5-hour window at 0, $45.80 left, the pop over: the call keeps the mark.
